title: The starter wardrobe (Track P's P.08): eight garments, each fitted on all three bodies
creator: the FlatChat contributors
made: node tools/converter/scripts/make-wardrobe.ts: tools/blender/wardrobe/fit.py fits MakeHuman's garments on the three bodies with MPFB 2.0.18 in Blender 5.2.2 LTS (the body kits' pinned tools), then tools/converter/src/item/wardrobe.ts gives each fit the weights of the skin under it, pushes it out where skin still came through, simplifies the denser ones under their slot's caps, keeps one base colour texture each and paints MakeHuman's logo out of the white tee; what each measured is in kits/items/wardrobe.json
